chunks: Al-Sadiq (عليه السلام) said regarding a woman who intentionally killed her husband, and he said:
If his family wishes to kill her, they may kill her, and no one commits more than his own crime against himself.

key_terms.أَهْلُهُ: his family or heirs, those entitled to seek retaliation
key_terms.امْرَأَةٍ: a woman, the subject of the legal case
key_terms.جِنَايَتِهِ: his crime or offense, the wrongful act for which one is liable
key_terms.زَوْجَهَا: her husband, the victim in the ruling
key_terms.عَلَى نَفْسِهِ: against himself, indicating personal legal responsibility

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a woman intentionally kills her husband in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a woman who intentionally kills her husband, stating that his heirs may exact retaliation against her. It also affirms the principle that liability does not extend beyond the offender’s own crime.
